name: FT_0_full_mid
export_rule: no epoch evaluated after the switch: the saved candidate with the lowest recorded TS-near metric (old all-structure best_ema, epoch 93)

selection.previous_metric: val force MAE over all validation structures (EMA) [mae_f_kcal_A]

decisions.FTF-sel: user 11-06: best checkpoint, ReduceLROnPlateau and early stop use the validation TS-near force MAE (EMA). Resume of a last.pt written by the old code (no TS fields): best_ts_epoch / best_ts_metric = first strict argmin / min of mae_f_ts_kcal_A over the history records (records without it skipped); early-stop counter = last epoch - best_ts_epoch; the current lr is kept; scheduler.best = best_ts_metric, num_bad_epochs = min(patience, number of epochs after best_ts_epoch at which the scheduler stepped (epoch >= 3)) (= min(since-best, patience) whenever best_ts_epoch >= 2), cooldown_counter 0, so with mode min / threshold 0 rel a stale run reduces the lr at its next non-improving epoch. Weights of the historical TS-near best exist only when best_ts_epoch is the epoch of the old best_ema (all-structure best) or the last epoch (EMA of last.pt); else ts_best_weights = 'not retained (epoch N)'. From the switch on, best_ts_ema (EMA at the best TS-near metric seen) and best_ts_sw_ema (best TS-near among the epochs evaluated after the switch) are kept in last.pt; an epoch after the switch that beats best_ts_metric becomes the best (weights kept). The old best_ema.pt is renamed best_ema_allF_legacy.pt at the migration and is never exported.
decisions.FTF-export: export weights (final train export and the interim `export` command): the TS-near best if its weights are kept; else the best TS-near since the switch; else (no epoch evaluated after the switch) the saved candidate (old all-structure best_ema or last-epoch EMA) with the lowest recorded TS-near metric. export_epoch / export_metric (TS-near) / export_rule go to the card and the train json. The all-structure best is never exported.
